PRECONDITIONS
Incident is correlated with a recent deployment (ACA score < 70 or error spike)
Previous stable deployment artifact is available in registry
Admin role approval AND secondary confirmation confirmed
GOVERNANCE & SAFETY
Required Role: ADMIN
Applicable Services: payment-service, checkout-api, auth-gateway-v2, *
Verification: Verify telemetry adapter reports canary traffic == 0% and p99 latency restored to nominal baseline.

inspect_recent_logs

Simulate Argo Rollouts undo / traffic drain to instantly revert 10% canary traffic to stable.

⚠️ Remediation Action

Confirm p99 latency drops below 50ms and error budget burn rate returns to 0.

Params: {"maxAcceptable":50,"expectedMetric":"latencyP99","expectedStatus":"nominal"}
